chapter: Lucky Millinder and Duke Ellington's band, 1948-52
title: Band changes in fall 1950: Cat Anderson back, trumpets
summary: Al Killian left and Cat Anderson returned; Francis Williams and Nelson Williams are sorted out.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Now, that band -- when I joined that band we had, like I told you, we had -- the personnel changed.
It changed. Al Killian left. Cat Anderson came back.
That was 1950, the fall of '50. Al Killian -- I mean, Cat came back in the band. And we also had a trumpet player, Nelson Williams, that had been in the band in Francis Williams' place.
